points.point: Does moving a scheduled post to drafts get it published by accident?
points.sentence: Moving to drafts removes the schedule without publishing.

points.point: If I only want to change the time, is that a different button?
points.sentence: To change only the time, use Reschedule instead.

verdict.reason: The move-to-drafts entry states both answers in its own sentences: moving to drafts removes the schedule without publishing, and changing only the time uses Reschedule instead.
